title: Mount a puck and measure properties
summary: Load a sample puck, collect a temperature and field sequence, return the field to zero, and then warm the sample to room temperature. Placeholder content written from general laboratory practice, not from the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Check the system status
steps.body: Review the status display and the previous session notes for active faults or unfinished sequences. Confirm that cooling and gas services are ready, the field is at zero, and the sample chamber is at room temperature before starting sample access.
steps.caution: An idle sequence does not prove that the magnet field is zero or that the sample is warm.

steps.title: Vent and purge the sample chamber for access
steps.body: Run the sample-chamber vent/purge cycle using the sample-exchange controls to reach access pressure (SOP: __ [pressure units: __]). Wait for cycle completion and the access-ready indication before opening the top port.

steps.title: Open the sample access
steps.body: Open the designated top sample port only after the software reports that the vent/purge cycle has completed and access pressure is safe. Lift the access deck as directed by the local loading procedure.
steps.caution: The animated front shell is schematic; remove only covers explicitly identified for routine sample access in the local procedure.
steps.check: Field is zero, sample chamber is at room temperature, and pressure is safe for sample access.

steps.title: Mount the sample puck
steps.body: Secure the specimen to a compatible puck and check that its contacts and dimensions meet the local loading limits. Use the designated insertion tool to seat the puck without forcing it, keeping wires clear of the access path.
steps.caution: Loose wires or an incompletely seated puck can snag during insertion and give intermittent measurements.

steps.title: Close the access
steps.body: Withdraw the insertion tool and inspect the accessible seal for debris. Lower and secure the access deck, then refit the sample-access cap without trapping wires.

steps.title: Purge and seal the chamber
steps.body: Start the approved sample-chamber purge and sealing cycle using the configured gas supply. Wait for the chamber status to indicate that the cycle has completed and the pressure is suitable for measurement (SOP pressure range: __ to __ [units: __]).
steps.caution: Cooling before the purge is complete can trap moisture and contaminate the sample chamber.
steps.check: Access is secured, the purge is complete, and chamber pressure is within the approved measurement range.

steps.title: Set the measurement sequence
steps.body: Enter the sample identifier, measurement mode, and data location. Set the approved temperature points (SOP: __ K), field points (SOP: __ Oe), ramp rates (SOP temperature ramp: __ K/min; field ramp: __ Oe/s), settling criteria (SOP stability bands: __ K, __ Oe; hold: __ s), and excitation (SOP limit and units: __). End the sequence with Set Field 0 Oe, wait for zero-field completion, then Set Temperature 300 K using the approved warming rate (SOP: __ K/min). Review the complete sequence before enabling it.

steps.title: Run and monitor the measurement
steps.body: Start the sequence and watch the first temperature and field transitions until the readings settle. Check the first data points for plausible values, and stop the sequence through the controls if faults or unexpected heating appear.

steps.title: Zero the field, then warm the sample
steps.body: Finish the acquisition and save the data with the sequence settings. Execute the final Set Field 0 Oe command at the field ramp rate entered in the sequence and wait for confirmed zero-field completion. Then execute Set Temperature 300 K at the approved warming rate entered in the sequence and wait for a stable reading. Keep the access closed and continue to end of session for the access-pressure cycle and unloading.
